_comment: Map each field (left) to the column name in YOUR CSV (right). Required: timestamp, sender_account, receiver_account, and amount_paid or amount_received. Delete lines your data does not have: banks default to a single institution, currency and payment format to 'Unknown', and without is_laundering the report shows scores, alerts and cases only (no accuracy). is_laundering accepts 1/0, true/false or yes/no.
